traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): Staphyleaceae (about 45 of 66 species) opposite; Stachyuraceae, Strasburgeriaceae spiral, Aphloia two-ranked.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): opposite in Staphyleaceae, Guamatelaceae, Geissolomataceae; spiral or two-ranked in the others.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): shrubs and trees only.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): all shrubs or trees.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): evergreen in Aphloiaceae, Guamatelaceae, Geissolomataceae, Strasburgeriaceae; Staphyleaceae and Stachyuraceae either; Crossosomataceae deciduous.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence terminal.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): no monosymmetric flowers described.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): ovary stipitate on the receptacle, superior.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): Staphyleaceae 2-3(-4), Guamatela 3, Stachyurus 4, Crossosomataceae 1-5.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Crossosomatales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers mostly perfect; Crossosomataceae polygamo-monoecious; cryptic dioecy possible in Stachyurus.
